description:
intent=i005 snapshot=s04 branch=pull-invalidates-pointer status=complete
finding location=net/802/garp.c:447-456 confidence=medium conclusion=garp_pdu_parse_attr() caches ga=skb->data, pskb_may_pull(skb, ga->len) can free/move the head, then ga->len/ga->event/ga->data are read through the stale pointer, giving a remotely reachable slab-UAF read on non-linear GARP PDUs (medium confidence).
finding location=drivers/net/ppp/ppp_generic.c:3111-3172 confidence=medium conclusion=ppp_ccp_peek() caches dp=skb->data+2, pskb_may_pull(skb, len+2) with the peer-chosen CCP length can free/move the head, and dp is then offset/dereferenced and passed to decomp_init/comp_init, a peer-reachable slab-UAF read on non-linear CCP packets (medium confidence).
unresolved location=net/openvswitch/flow.c:457 conclusion=Read net/openvswitch/flow.c parse_vlan() (approx. lines 450-480) to check whether vh is re-derived after pskb_may_pull and whether the skb can be non-linear at that point.
unresolved location=net/mac80211/rx.c:2985 conclusion=Read net/mac80211/rx.c mesh forwarding path (approx. lines 2960-3030) to determine whether mesh_hdr survives a pskb_may_pull without refetch.
unresolved location=net/mac80211/wpa.c:538 conclusion=Read net/mac80211/wpa.c ieee80211_ccmp_gcmp_decrypt (approx. lines 530-620) and the 750-820 variant to check for stale hdr use after pskb_may_pull.
unresolved location=net/nfc/hci/core.c:912 conclusion=Read net/nfc/hci/core.c around lines 905-930 to check whether hcp_skb->data pointers are re-derived after pskb_may_pull and whether NFC HCI skbs can be non-linear.
unresolved location=net/ipv6/seg6.c:91 conclusion=Read net/ipv6/seg6.c seg6_do_srh() region (approx. lines 85-110) to confirm the refetch after pskb_may_pull is present.
unresolved location=net/ipv6/ip6_tunnel.c:423 conclusion=Read net/ipv6/ip6_tunnel.c ipv6_skip_exthdr (approx. lines 415-470) to verify hdr is refetched after each pskb_may_pull.
unresolved location=net/ipv6/ip6_gre.c:513 conclusion=Read net/ipv6/ip6_gre.c approx. lines 505-560 and net/ipv4/ip_gre.c approx. lines 300-350 to check whether ershdr is re-derived after pskb_may_pull.
coverage_gap=Only the ~60 highest-scoring save/pull/use triples from the 182 pskb_may_pull-bearing files in net/ and drivers/ were read in full; the remaining ~120 lower-scoring files were never line-read.
coverage_gap=Bare skb_pull()/pskb_pull()/__pskb_pull callers (59 grep hits) were never systematically enumerated for pointers cached across the pull; only ones surfaced incidentally (garp, ife) were checked.
coverage_gap=The six unresolved candidates (openvswitch/flow.c, mac80211/rx.c, mac80211/wpa.c, nfc/hci/core.c, ipv6/seg6.c, ipv6/ip6_tunnel.c, ip6_gre.c/ip_gre.c) were flagged by the scanner but not read to a safe/reported conclusion.
coverage_gap=No runtime reproducer or KASAN build was produced to confirm that garp_pdu_parse_attr and ppp_ccp_peek actually receive non-linear skbs on any concrete driver configuration.
limitation=Both findings are hypotheses from source reading of the exact save/pull/use lines, not from execution; a non-linear skb is required because pskb_may_pull on an already-linear head is a no-op.
limitation=The garp finding's stale ga->data read is bounded (2 bytes of freed head at a time) and the skb_pull(skb, ga->len) uses the pre-pull validated value, so it is a UAF read rather than a write; exploit impact was not assessed beyond crash/infoleak.
limitation=The ppp finding requires a PPP channel that delivers non-linear skbs and a peer-negotiated CCP ConfAck with attacker-chosen CCP length; reachability of non-linear skbs per ppp channel driver was not audited.
limitation=The scanner's function-extent heuristic (column-0 braces) and single-line derivation matching can mis-scope large functions and miss multi-line pointer derivations, so false negatives among the 354 flagged triples cannot be excluded.
limitation=Seed code net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb (lines 46-67) was located in s04 but excluded from reporting by assignment; it still exhibits the unpatched save-pull-stale-deref shape.
